steps.title: Sync with the base branch
steps.prompt: Merge {{inputs.branch}} into the current branch, then merge the latest {{inputs.base_branch}} into it and resolve any conflicts, keeping both sides' intent. Commit. Do not push.

steps.title: Pre-landing review
steps.prompt: Tests passed: {{steps.test.outputs.passed}}. Review the full diff of this folder against {{inputs.base_branch}}: bugs, missed call sites, untested paths, secrets, and a local production build. Write {{run.dir}}/review.json as a list of findings with severity, title, file, line and detail. Set the output key findings to that path. Do not edit the code.

steps.title: Bump version and changelog
steps.prompt: Bump the version for what the diff against {{inputs.base_branch}} changed, add a CHANGELOG entry in plain words, and fix any doc the diff made wrong. Commit. Do not push. Set title to a short pull request title and summary to the changelog entry.

steps.title: Approve opening the pull request
steps.gate_summary: Review findings: {{steps.review.outputs.findings}}. Approve to push {{steps.sync.outputs.branch}} and open a pull request on {{inputs.repo}} into {{inputs.base_branch}}.

steps.title: Push and open the pull request
Approve the deploy
steps.gate_summary: Pull request: {{steps.open-pr.outputs.url}}. CI: {{steps.ci.outputs.state}}. Approve to deploy {{steps.sync.outputs.branch}} to production. Merging the pull request stays yours.

steps.title: Watch production
steps.prompt: Open {{steps.deploy.outputs.url}} in your browser pane and watch it for 10 minutes: console errors, failed pages and requests, and load speed on the main pages. Write {{run.dir}}/canary.json as a list of findings with severity, title and detail. Set the output key findings to that path, and healthy to true or false.

steps.title: Keep or roll back
steps.gate_summary: Production healthy: {{steps.canary.outputs.healthy}}. Read {{run.dir}}/canary.json. Continue keeps the deploy. To roll back, redeploy the previous version yourself, then Continue.
